last_verified.normal_state: On codex/integration-next-phase, integrated development foundation, capability/permission, App SDK contracts, Wayback host ledger, localization, model-manager host contract, diagnostics, and centralized acceptance tooling. Diagnostics remains PARTIAL due an inherited optional VM smoke timeout; the host health check now invokes the authoritative DF-01 validator. Acceptance tooling is PARTIAL pending public CI: the CLI and bootstrap suites pass, both M0 host wrappers pass, x86_64 nagi-net tests and Clippy pass, and the CI runner preserves the existing M17 wrapper/checksum/marker gate. A native arm64 nagi-net test attempt fails in libnagi's x86-64 syscall inline assembly; no host escape or source weakening was added. Mainline M17 remains BLOCKED: CI #233 showed a 512-byte allocation failure after Servo construction and no pixel checksum or marker. Runs #36228221098 and #36228898043 have passed Ubuntu/Windows host jobs and remain in M17 target QEMU acceptance; neither includes the acceptance-runner merge. M18 remains NOT STARTED. No models, inference, target crash store, production runtime hooks, or first-party runtime paths were activated; dirty UI/Home/Search and M17 diagnosis worktrees remain untouched.

ci_runs.summary: Diagnostics integration run: Ubuntu and Windows host jobs passed; nagi-target remains in the existing M17 QEMU acceptance. This head predates the acceptance-runner merge.
Acceptance-CI source branch failed host Clippy on subsec_nanos() / 1_000. Integration uses subsec_micros(); focused x86_64-target nagi-net tests and Clippy pass.

Pre-diagnostics integration checkpoint including the aligned allocation fix: Ubuntu and Windows host jobs passed; nagi-target is still running the M17 QEMU first-web-pixel acceptance. This run does not include the diagnostics merge commit.

Diagnostics source branch failed compiling nagi-bootstrap because the separate package omitted direct dependencies required by the shared CLI library. The integration branch adds serde and updates the standalone lockfile; local bootstrap check and Clippy pass.

Mainline run #233: Ubuntu and Windows host jobs passed and target builds reached UEFI. QEMU reached Servo construction, then failed a 512-byte allocation and timed out at 120 seconds; no heap mapping/no-free-block diagnostic, pixel checksum, or M17 PASS marker.
Both host jobs passed DF-01 verification. The target build completed, then the unchanged M17 QEMU acceptance timed out before a web pixel.

Capability source-branch CI failed the old DF-01 test expecting IN_PROGRESS after development-foundation recorded PASS; isolated capability crate checks passed. The stale assertion is corrected in this integration branch.
App SDK source-branch CI failed the same old DF-01 status assertion; SDK format, Clippy, and build passed, target job skipped. The stale assertion is corrected in this integration branch.

Wayback source-branch CI passed formatting, lint, and build but both host test jobs failed an inherited DF-01 status assertion; the target job was skipped. The integration branch updates that stale assertion.
Pre-aligned-allocation integration checkpoint: Ubuntu and Windows host jobs passed; target job had reached M17 first-web-pixel QEMU acceptance. This run does not include commit 55be56d.
Localization source branch: Ubuntu and Windows host jobs and target builds through UEFI passed; only the unrelated M17 first-web-pixel QEMU acceptance failed.

Model Runtime source branch: Ubuntu host passed; Windows failed the newline-sensitive malformed-manifest fixture; target M17 acceptance failed independently after builds through UEFI. The CRLF regression is fixed in the integration tree.
